name: Campbellian Monomyth Brand Adaptation
diagnostic: What threshold of change is our customer hesitant to cross, and how does our brand serve as the mentor providing the tools to succeed?
artifact: A 12-stage journey map: Ordinary World, Call to Adventure, Refusal of the Call, Meeting the Mentor, Crossing the Threshold, Tests/Allies/Enemies, Inmost Cave, Supreme Ordeal, Reward, The Road Back, Resurrection, Return with the Elixir.
trap: Melodramatizing low-involvement or routine purchases, alienating practical buyers.
pedigreeFull: Joseph Campbell (*The Hero with a Thousand Faces*, 1949), adapted for modern narrative analysis by Christopher Vogler (*The Writer’s Journey*, 1992).
